issuer: the Direcção de Trânsito e Segurança Rodoviária (DTSER) of the Polícia Nacional
note: Read 2026-10-31 on the DTSER's own FAQ page on the driving licence (dtser.pn.gov.ao, which answered this time): the DTSER is the body competent to issue driving licences; the minimum age is 18 for categories A, B and EB (vehicles up to 3,500 kg tare), 21 for a professional licence (Código de Estrada art. 124; Presidential Decree 203/16 of 29 September, the regulation on driving instruction and licensing). The page gives neither the first licence's fee nor its term, so both are null: the press (Expansão, ANGOP) reports a renewal fee of 17,012 Kz under Presidential Decree 148/21 against the 40,052 Kz the DNVT charges, and a term extended to 15 years for drivers 18 to 64, but those are renewal figures and press readings, not used.
